role: READ_ONLY_CACHED_EFFECTIVE_STATE_EXPORT; not initialization, inverse proof or actual admission

scalar_representation.bounds: [lo_exact,hi_exact] as rational strings, covering native hex; float JSON values refused
scalar_representation.raw_link: exact archive/file/member/path/hash and accepted initialization linkage; a boolean is insufficient

ede_only.scf_parameters: entire post-shooting array, not the requested placeholder 1,1,1,1,1,0.0

neutrino_per_species.w_ncdm_bg: all effective weights including distribution weighting

required_theta_fields.representation: Each scalar: source field name, unit, exact native hex/bit pattern if available, exact rational interval, derivation, raw-field linkage and bound type. Missing values cannot be replaced by booleans or requested inputs.

identity_routes.requirement: Existing serialized, already accepted initialized instance or complete archived effective fields linked to original case/binary/input hashes. Read-only export; never silently initialize, re-shoot or rebuild a native model to obtain it.

Solve source algebra plus rounded-output inverse constraints with rigorously bounded output/libm errors, retain every consistent parameter/state box, certify completeness and link to original accepted initialization. The previous approximate first-row inversion is not such a certificate.

neutrino_rules: all effective nodes/weights, distribution weighting, mass, normalization, files/hash/strategy; declare finite, analytic FD or common enclosing reference; do not retune closure
guard_rules: binary64 threshold hex, multiplication order, rounding/build/libm assumptions separately documented; exact-real certificate is not source-binary equivalence
result_rules: audit_export validates representation/completeness only. PT01/PT03/actual admission unresolved until original initialized-instance and IVP/error evidence are qualified.
